text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 15

An all-female panel is not evidence of bias; composition usually reflects designated administrative roles or internal availability. In senior municipal planning roles, extensive public consultation experience and stakeholder management often align better with strategic priorities than formal licensing or an advanced degree. Furthermore, a two-week delay for written feedback is standard in local government HR.

Making an issue of the panel's gender without concrete evidence of procedural unfairness or discriminatory conduct will appear speculative and could severely harm your professional reputation. Focus instead on sending a courteous follow-up to request constructive feedback on your interview performance.
